clauses: Only include observatories that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table.
Include every observatory in the observatories table, counting those with no telescopes as zero.
readings: Count the telescopes at each observatory (`observstation` in the telescopes table) and express each observatory's share of all telescopes as a fraction between 0 and 1 (its count ÷ the total across all observatories). Considering only the observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, give one summary row with: the average telescope count, the average share, and the average amount by which their share exceeds the average share. Don't round anything. Only include observatories that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table.

Count the telescopes at each observatory (`observstation` in the telescopes table) and express each observatory's share of all telescopes as a fraction between 0 and 1 (its count ÷ the total across all observatories). Considering only the observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, give one summary row with: the average telescope count, the average share, and the average amount by which their share exceeds the average share. Don't round anything. Include every observatory in the observatories table, counting those with no telescopes as zero.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_over_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
